title: model catalog: add capability flags, pricing & limits fields; streaming & OpenAI-compat updates
author: Nikhil Rao
release_notes: Add capability flags (supports_streaming, supports_function_calling, supports_structured_output, openai_compatible) to model catalog responses; extend listing filters to allow querying by capability and pricing/limits; add pricing fields (token_price_input, token_price_output) and limits (concurrency_limit, rate_limit_per_minute); update API docs and OpenAI compatibility layer to map capability flags.
description:
Motivation: downstream teams (Console, SDKs, and gateway routing) need first-class metadata on model capabilities and pricing so we can route requests, enforce limits, and display accurate product info. This PR adds capability flags and pricing/limits fields to the model-catalog endpoints and extends the listing API with filters for capabilities and price/limit ranges. It also contains a small set of OpenAI-compat mapping changes so the compatibility layer surfaces equivalent flags for allowed client behavior.

Summary of changes: - Add capability flags to model schema: supports_streaming, supports_function_calling, supports_structured_output, openai_compatible (boolean flags). - Add pricing fields: token_price_input, token_price_output (USD per 1k tokens as strings for precision), and public_tier label. - Add limits fields: concurrency_limit, rate_limit_per_minute, max_context_tokens. - Extend GET /models and GET /models/{id} responses to include the above fields. - Add query params to GET /models: ?capability=streaming|function_calling|structured_output|openai_compat and ?min_price=...,?max_price=...,?min_concurrency=... to help Console and routing tier. - Update OpenAI-compat wrapper to translate OpenAI capability expectations to our flags (e.g., streaming => supports_streaming). - Streaming stability notes: make streaming compatibility explicit; when supports_streaming=false the streaming endpoint will reject with a clear 422 and docs-driven guidance. - Docs+SDK: update redwood-docs and SDK compatibility layer to expose new fields and filters.

Migration notes: - Existing catalog entries default to supports_* = false unless populated during model onboarding. - Pricing fields default to empty string to avoid accidental billing changes until explicitly set. - Backwards compatibility: clients that only consume previous minimal model records are unaffected; new SDKs will surface flags via optional fields.

Testing: unit tests added for schema validation, listing filters and serialization. Integration tests cover OpenAI-compat mapping and streaming rejection for models without supports_streaming. Manual smoke tested in staging with Console filters and dedicated routing.

Checklist: - [x] API schema updates - [x] Listing filter implementation - [x] OpenAI-compat mapping - [x] Docs + SDK examples - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Performance check (no measurable 95p latency regressions on catalog endpoints)

References: Linear ENG-3412 (model-catalog capability metadata), ENG-3478 (gateway routing by capability), SUP-1021 (customer question about surfaceable streaming flag).
